title.narrative: Policy for better learning: Starting early with quality and equitable measures

description.narrative: As part of UNESCO´s efforts to strengthen equity, quality and inclusion within education systems, attention will be given to the ECCE sub-sector and to learning environments and curricular resources that increase the participation of vulnerable populations in quality learning. ECCE is a fundamental and integral part of human development as it sets the solid foundation for equal lifelong educational and societal opportunities for every child. In line with SDG Target 4.2, calling MS to ‘ensure that all girls and boys have access to quality early childhood development, care and pre-primary education so that they are ready for primary education’, the Tashkent Declaration reaffirms the right of every young child to quality early childhood care and education (ECCE) from birth to 8 years of age. Building on the Guiding principles and Commitments to Action of the Tashkent Declaration, UNESCO Montevideo will promote and support ECCE initiatives in countries in the region via policy dialogue, knowledge generation, advocacy, partnership building and technical advice.
